name: PlayChoosenShow

parameters.help_en:
The production studio ID.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, check the CasterId parameter in the response.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, navigate to ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio to view the production studio name.

The production studio name in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID.
The production studio must be in the running (Status=1) state. Otherwise, the IncorrectCasterStatus error is returned. For a production studio in the idle state, call StartCaster to start the production studio first
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台路径查看导播台名称。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
导播台必须处于运行中（Status=1）状态，否则返回 IncorrectCasterStatus错误。对于空闲状态的导播台，可以先调用StartCaster 启动导播台
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the show to switch to.
You can obtain the ShowId value from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848051.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848054.html operation
